lead_html: The weir redrawn as you ruled 2026-10-16: "(1) but in the four art styles", and by card, weirs join into one continuous wall. A low timber wall with a level crest, in the four FlowWorks looks (Scrapper, Industrial, Modern, Futuristic), one picture per heading. The game picks the heading from the river's current, so the spill face is always downstream. Wall pictures are seamless along the wall: sections built end to end out into the current read as one wall, and a post is drawn only at a free end. Water is a separate overlay layer, not baked into the wall: a calm pool tint upstream and white foam at the toe (under the wall, the same in every look) plus a thin spill sheet over the crest (above the wall). The overlay shows only while the weir holds; a breach removes it. The joined-wall pictures on the E-W rows are OFFLINE composites on a synthetic river, not a game capture (the game is up on other work; an in-game look is owed). Installed, not yet deployed.
